title: U.S. House · Michigan's 13th District
area: Detroit and nearby Wayne County communities including parts of the city's east and south sides.

context.text: Incumbent Shri Thanedar (D) is not on the November ballot: state Rep. Donavan McKinney defeated him in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary, 51.9% to 48.1% (57,714 to 53,494 votes). Taras Nykoriak won the Republican primary unopposed.

candidates.name: Donavan McKinney
candidates.ballotNote: Defeated incumbent Rep. Shri Thanedar in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary, 51.9%-48.1%.

priorities.text: Raising taxes on billionaires and corporations to fund housing, education and healthcare investments.
priorities.quote: That starts with making the ultra-wealthy like Elon Musk, Donald Trump, and Congressman Shri Thanedar pay their fair share... Raising taxes on billionaires and corporations could fund crucial investments our community needs for housing, education, clean air & water, fair paying jobs and healthcare.

priorities.text: A 'Green New Deal' transition to 100% clean energy, citing lead and air pollution in the district.
priorities.quote: A Green New Deal transitioning to 100% clean and renewable energy, would protect our planet's future and create millions of good-paying green union jobs in Michigan.

priorities.text: Medicare for All, including reproductive and abortion care coverage.
priorities.quote: I know our families cannot afford anything less than Medicare for All... Medicare for All would include coverage for dental, vision, mental health, reproductive health and abortion care.

positions.summary: Supports raising taxes on billionaires and corporations.
positions.quote: Raising taxes on billionaires and corporations could fund crucial investments our community needs for housing, education, clean air & water, fair paying jobs and healthcare.

positions.summary: Supports a Green New Deal-style transition to 100% clean and renewable energy.
positions.quote: A Green New Deal transitioning to 100% clean and renewable energy, would protect our planet's future and create millions of good-paying green union jobs in Michigan.
I know our families cannot afford anything less than Medicare for All, which would ensure everyone in this country has healthcare.

positions.summary: Campaign site says Congress must codify abortion rights at the federal level and protect nationwide access to medication abortion.
positions.quote: We must codify abortion rights at the federal level and particularly protect access to medication abortion nationwide

positions.summary: Campaign site opposes mass deportations and calls for shutting down for-profit immigration detention centers.
positions.quote: opposes this agenda of mass deportations, internment camps, and the criminalization of immigrant communities

positions.summary: Campaign site calls for ending U.S. military aid and arms transfers to Israel.
positions.quote: We need to end the military aid and arms that America gives to Israel

record.text: Serves on the Michigan House Appropriations Committee, 2023-2026 sessions.
Defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Shri Thanedar in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary, 51.9% to 48.1%.

priorities.text: Federal marijuana decriminalization and relief for past low-level marijuana convictions.
priorities.quote: TP Nykoriak believes Congress should work with the President to remove marijuana from the federal list of controlled substances where appropriate and modernize federal law.

priorities.text: Ending qualified immunity for federal officers, including Border Patrol and ICE agents, who knowingly violate constitutional rights.
priorities.quote: TP Nykoriak will introduce legislation to substantially reform qualified immunity for federal law enforcement officers, including Border Patrol agents and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers, when they knowingly violate clearly established constitutional rights.

priorities.text: Stronger congressional oversight of U.S. foreign assistance spending, including aid related to Ukraine.
priorities.quote: TP Nykoriak will advocate for comprehensive congressional oversight and investigations into the expenditure of U.S. funds and materials provided for foreign conflicts, including assistance related to Ukraine and other overseas operations.

statements.quote: TP Nykoriak will fight to protect Medicare and Medicaid for those who lawfully depend upon these programs while working to eliminate fraud, waste, and abuse that threaten their long-term stability.
